verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents LLM observability, evaluations, and experiments that measure how prompt changes affect performance, and it mentions dataset versioning. It shows no prompt registry, prompt versioning, or way to deploy prompt changes to production without a code release. Experiments and dataset versioning are related features, and Change Tracking only monitors deployments; neither counts as prompt management.

support.subject: As a developer, I can version prompts and deploy changes to production without shipping code
